data.name: Muammar
data.long_meaning: Muammar is a name derived from the Arabic root 'm-r-m', which means 'commander of an army'. In Islamic history, Muammar bin Abdul Wadud is known as the legendary Berber general who defended against the invading Byzantine and Roman forces. This name is a reminder of strength and resilience in the face of adversity.

in_urdu.name: معمّر

Muammar's legendary accomplishments continue to inspire and have an impact on the Islamic community, particularly in North Africa, where his name remains a source of pride and celebration.
